Native Hawaiian (Kanaka Maoli) foodways -- kalo (taro) and its poi, ulu (breadfruit), and the land-stewardship concept of malama aina -- are sacred and central; reference ONLY with explicit consent and cultural guidance, NEVER as decoration or an endorsement, and never appropriate poi/kalo imagery without a Native Hawaiian partner (source: general framing; Native Hawaiian cultural-protocol note)

Hawaii is deeply multicultural (Native Hawaiian, Japanese, Filipino, Chinese, Samoan, Portuguese) with a rich mixed-plate food culture; island logistics make bulk-and-shipping shopping common (source: general demographic framing, publicly documented)
Foodland (a beloved local Hawaii chain) and Times Supermarket anchor grocery, with a strong Costco presence given island shipping economics (source: chain regional footprint)
